ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_log_ratio_softplus_advantage_exp_stack_mean
ir.intuition: Rearrange aggregation to first compute softplus of scaled log-ratio, then sum pair losses separately by weight and weighted loss, finally take the mean ratio, stabilizing by decoupling sum aggregation with pairwise weighting before averaging.
ir.pseudocode:
ratio = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
scale_factor = exp(advantage_gap)
loss = softplus(-ratio * scale_factor)
weighted_loss = loss * weight
sum_loss = sum(weighted_loss)
sum_weight = sum(weight)
final_loss = sum_loss / sum_weight
